builtinSkills.brand-tokens.description: Built-in brand design library with color, typography, radius tokens, and visual guidelines for brands such as Airbnb, Stripe, Apple, Linear, Notion, and Figma. Use when a design should follow a brand. See ./brands.md and ./brands/<brand>/DESIGN.md.
builtinSkills.creation-flow-features.des: Project creation: refine feature scope and turn a broad idea into an MVP after clarifying intent.
builtinSkills.creation-flow-cost.descrip: Project creation: check deployment, AI, and budget against confirmed features and help resolve cost tradeoffs.
builtinSkills.creation-flow-prototype.de: Project creation: produce an interactive prototype for user approval after confirming requirements for a UI project of moderate complexity or greater.
builtinSkills.untrusted-source-check.des: Inspect external sources before installing third-party packages, running downloaded installers or scripts, or introducing external code and binaries. Read the content first, check its source when needed, and report a conclusion. Routine project commands and explicitly requested official packages are excluded.
builtinSkills.dev-docs.description: Project documentation rules for user to-dos, requirements, development records, dated logs, CHANGELOG, and architecture. Covers ownership, progress snapshots, handoffs, releases, and maintenance.
builtinSkills.ui-aesthetic.description: Guidelines for UI, components, icons, colors, layout, spacing, and visual polish. Covers inline SVG icons, typography, motion, and a delivery checklist to avoid a generic AI-generated appearance.
builtinSkills.creation-flow-techspec.des: Project creation: define the technical plan after prototype approval, verify the environment, and write task.json.
builtinSkills.project-run.description: Configure project launch commands and common run, build, package, install, release, and deployment scripts. Provides the .easymint/run.json format.
builtinSkills.creation-guide.description: Guide project creation from a vague idea to actionable requirements, following the project creation checklist.
builtinSkills.ui-sync.description: Keep UI state synchronized with newly requested features and tasks. Applies to new requirements, not existing-feature changes, bug fixes, or configuration changes.
builtinSkills.creation-flow-intent.descr: Project creation: clarify a vague idea into concrete goals when the user starts a project.
